newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bajaj introduces new two-wheeler in Goa.
newsitem.headline: India Bajaj introduces new two-wheeler in Goa.

text.p: Indian automobile firm Bajaj Auto Ltd said it introduced Rave, a new 74-cc, two-stroke two-wheeler in the western state of Goa last week.
"The three-gear, 74-cc engine delivers an average of 55 km per litre during normal riding conditions," it said. Bajaj said it delivered more than 100 vehicles in Goa last week.
Automobile analysts said the new product was launched in the western city of Pune, headquarters of Bajaj Automobiles, some months ago.
"It is a cross between a moped and a scooter, a segment for which Bajaj had no product earlier," said an analyst.
